description: Line-by-line buyer closing costs — lender fees, title, appraisal, transfer taxes, prepaid escrow — plus total cash needed at the table including the down payment. Marks which items are worth shopping for and which are fixed by the county, and adds the FHA upfront premium, VA funding fee or USDA guarantee fee where they apply.

inputSchema.description: Itemised buyer closing costs and total cash needed at the table.

downPaymentPercent.description: Down payment as a percentage of the purchase price, 0 to 100. Not a dollar amount.

escrowMonths.description: Months of taxes collected up front to open the escrow account.

homePrice.description: Purchase price of the home in US dollars.

loanType.description: Loan programme. Affects mortgage insurance and upfront fees.

propertyTaxRatePercent.description: Annual property tax as a percentage of home value. Omit and pass `state` instead to use that state's average.

state.description: Full US state name, for example "Texas". Used to look up the average property tax rate. Either this or propertyTaxRatePercent is required.

transferTaxPercent.description: State and local transfer tax as a percentage of price. Varies enormously by state.

vaExemptFromFundingFee.description: VA only: exempt from the funding fee, for example a service-connected disability rating.

vaSubsequentUse.description: VA only: entitlement has been used before.

name: estimate_closing_costs

outputSchema.description: Itemised closing cost estimate and cash needed to close.

cashToClose.description: Down payment plus closing costs, in dollars.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

lineItems.description: Itemised costs, each with a label and amount.

shoppableTotal.description: Portion of the costs a borrower can shop around for, in dollars.

totalAsPercentOfPrice.description: Total closing costs as a percentage of the price.

totalClosingCosts.description: Sum of all items, in dollars.

typicalRange.description: Typical low and high total for this price.

title: Itemise closing costs
